name: Hard negative: a REAL bank fraud alert (must not block anything)

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: hi this is jenny from calhacks federal credit union's card services team is this margaret

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Yes, this is Margaret. Is everything alright?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: we noticed two charges on your debit card this morning one for 42 dollars at a gas station in fresno can you confirm the charge

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Fresno? Oh no, I haven't been to Fresno in years.

turns.text: okay no problem we'll decline that charge and mail you a new card you don't need to do anything else

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh, thank you dear. Do I need to move my money anywhere?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: no ma'am never move your money for us we will never ask for that if you want to double check call the number on the back of your card

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: That's very kind. Thank you, goodbye now.
